# mcp-bridge-go

> Go MCP server (stdio) that sends a prompt to an Electron-based AI IDE on macOS (Antigravity, Cursor, Windsurf) and returns the workspace git diff. Free, source-available under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/jangtrinh/mcp-bridge-go#readme): problem, how it works, configuration, tools and known limitations.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/jangtrinh/mcp-bridge-go/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): code standards and PR guidelines.
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/jangtrinh/mcp-bridge-go/blob/main/LICENSE): PolyForm Shield 1.0.0.

## Tools

- `send_to_app(prompt, workspacePath?, waitSeconds?)`: sends the prompt to the target app and waits for workspace changes (default 120 s).
- `check_workspace_changes(workspacePath?)`: returns git status, diff (up to 5 KB), untracked previews and 3 recent commits.

## Use with your agent

- Build: `git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/mcp-bridge-go.git && cd mcp-bridge-go && make build` (Go 1.26+, macOS).
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add mcp-bridge --env MCP_BRIDGE_APP=Cursor --env MCP_BRIDGE_WORKSPACE=/path/to/project -- /path/to/mcp-bridge`.
- Codex: add `[mcp_servers.mcp-bridge]` with `command` and an `env` table to `~/.codex/config.toml`.
- Cursor: add the server under `mcpServers` in `~/.cursor/mcp.json`.
- Configuration is environment variables only: `MCP_BRIDGE_APP`, `MCP_BRIDGE_SHORTCUT`, `MCP_BRIDGE_WORKSPACE`.

## FAQ

- Is it a Figma tool? No. For Figma see https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin.
- Which OS? macOS only, because it drives the target app with AppleScript and needs Accessibility permission.
- Does it run a model or need an API key? No.
- How does it detect completion? It polls git for workspace changes.
- Licence? Source-available under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0: free to use and modify, not for resale or building a competing product.
